title: Setups and mods
summary: Host Plain Realm of Thrones or your own setup with extra mods.

sections.heading: Setups
steps: Plain Realm of Thrones is the locked setup. It is exactly Realm of Thrones and its helper mods, in a fixed order.
To add mods, click New setup or Copy on the Mods page.
Every player must load the same extra mods, even interface mods.
Click Prepare server again after you change the mods.

sections.heading: The More menu on the Mods page
steps: Share mod list saves this setup to a file for your players.
Import mod list makes a setup from a file a player shared.
Auto sort can move the Realm of Thrones group past extra mods. The four modules stay together.

sections.heading: War Sails
steps: War Sails is always on, because Realm of Thrones needs it.
Realm of Thrones needs the War Sails DLC on every player's PC.
The server copies the War Sails files it needs from your own game, so keep the game installed on this PC.
